name: A Militia Recruit regains full health after losing a spar (#11306)
contract: Issue #11306. Talking to a Militia Recruit (255339) starts a spar; at 1% health it gives Militia Training credit, evades and offers the spar again. It used to evade at 1% health, so the same recruit could be beaten in one hit for every credit. It now returns to full health when it evades.

steps.label: SETUP: the beaten recruit stops at 1% health
CONTRACT: after the spar the recruit is back at full health
